summary: Smith & Nephew filed a Form 6-K attaching a TR-1 notification disclosing that Cevian Capital II GP Limited increased its aggregate voting rights in the company to 12.236% as of June 12, 2026, up from 12.074%. Cevian, an activist investment firm, holds the stake via Cevian Capital II Master Fund L.P. (11.049%) and Cevian Capital II Co-Investment - Series P L.P. (1.187%). The shares are held by Aurora Nominees as nominee. This filing signals continued activist building; the position increase suggests potential engagement on strategic direction. Watch for Cevian's next moves regarding board representation, operational changes, or a strategic review push.
